faces.name: Ms. Bumbleflower, No Longer Kind
text: Menace
When Ms. Bumbleflower enters, you become the head chef. (It's like the monarch but you create a Food token rather than draw a card.)

Whenever you cast a spell, each opponent blights 1. The blighted creature loses flying until end of turn. If this is the second spell you've cast this turn and you're the head chef, each opponent gets a poison counter.

Whenever The Alien Spellslayer enters or attacks, put a transformation counter on up to one target non-Alien creature. It becomes an Alien that's all colors.
Whenever an Alien you control attacks, it can't be blocked this combat.

text: (Theme color: {W})

faces.name: Pizza Parlor
text: Whenever a nontoken creature you control enters, create a Food token.
Whenever chaos ensues, you may sacrifice any number of artifacts. Creatures you control get +X/+X and gain haste until end of turn, where X is the number of artifacts sacrificed this way.

faces.name: Samut's Training Grounds
text: Creature spells cost {1} less to cast.
Creatures you control have haste.
Whenever chaos ensues, until end of turn, creatures you control can't be blocked except by creatures with haste.

faces.name: Jace's Bloomburrow
text: Creatures you control with power 4 or greater can't be blocked by creatures with lesser power.

As an additional cost to cast creature spells, you may pay {3}. If you do, when that creature enters, it bites target creature an opponent controls. (It deals damage equal to its power to that creature.)
Whenever chaos ensues, each creature your opponents control has base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.

faces.name: Navigator (Rank)
text: Evasive Maneuvers — Prevent the first 2 damage that would be dealt to you each turn.
Hyper Thrusters — {1}: Put a flying counter on target creature. Activate only once.

faces.name: Overstuffed Bicycle Rack
text: When you planeswalk here and at the beginning of each upkeep, you may draw a card. If you do, discard a card.
Cards in each player's hand have cycling 2.
Whenever chaos ensues, creatures you control get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards you've drawn this turn.

faces.name: Demo Tables
text: Play the Game, See the World — When you planeswalk here, each player may search their library for a basic land card, put it into their hand, then shuffle.
Here I Rule — Whenever you play a basic land card or a card with a Foundations or core set expansion symbol (Alpha counts!), draw a card.
Ignite Your Spark — Whenever chaos ensues, you gain life equal to the number of years you've played Magic. Then planeswalk.

faces.name: Secret Lair
text: When you planeswalk here, each player searches their library for a shiny card, reveals it, puts it into their hand, then shuffles. (Foil cards and Secret Lair cards are shiny.)
Shiny cards have protection from non-shiny cards.

Whenever chaos ensues, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a shiny nonland card. You may cast it without paying its mana cost. If you don't, put it into your hand. Put the other revealed cards on the bottom of your library in a random order.

39362.name: Your Turn at the Merch Booth

faces.name: Your Turn at the Merch Booth
text: When you encounter this phenomenon, each player gets @@@. Starting with you, each player may spend their @.
@@ — Draw a card.
@ — Create a 1/1 Fblthp Toy artifact creature token.
(Then planeswalk away from this phenomenon.)

faces.name: Showdown of the Supers
text: When you planeswalk here, each player secretly chooses to be a Super Hero or a Super Villain for as long as this plane is face up, then the choices are revealed.
Whenever a creature a Super Hero controls attacks a Super Villain, it gets +2/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn.
Whenever a Super Villain commits a crime, each Super Hero loses 2 life.

faces.name: Phoenix Nest
text: When you planeswalk here, this plane deals 4 damage to each creature without flying.
Creatures you control with flying have lifelink.
Whenever chaos ensues, return up to three target creature cards in your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on each of them. Creatures you control gain haste until end of turn.

faces.name: New Coopenna
text: When you planeswalk here and at the beginning of your upkeep, create three 1/1 white Pigeon creature tokens with flying.
Whenever chaos ensues, Pigeons you control gain annihilator 2 until end of turn. (Whenever a Pigeon you control attacks, defending player sacrifices two permanents of their choice.)

faces.name: Forbidden Peach Orchard
text: When you planeswalk here, each player draws a card. Then each player may put a land card from their hand onto the battlefield.
Whenever you tap a nonbasic land for mana, each opponent creates a Food token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: You gain 3 life.")
Whenever chaos ensues, create an 0/0 green Worm creature token with trample. Put X +1/+1 counters on it, where X is the number of Foods on the battlefield.

faces.name: Rule 104.3a
text: When you planeswalk here and at the beginning of your upkeep, flip a coin. If you win the flip, create a Mana Crypt token. If you lose the flip, each opponent creates a Treasure token.

Whenever chaos ensues, all players may agree to play a subgame. Each player who doesn't win the subgame loses half their life, rounded up. (Planar decks also go to the subgame, but this plane stays here. Rule 104.3a always applies, even after MagicCon is over.)

faces.name: Serra's Jace's Realm
text: When you planeswalk here, each player mills four cards, then they return an instant or sorcery card from their graveyard to their hand.

Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, create a 4/4 blue Angel Illusion creature token named Phantasmal Angel with flying and "When this token becomes the target of a spell or ability, sacrifice it."
Whenever chaos ensues, untap up to X target permanents, where X is 1 plus the number of Illusions you control.

faces.name: Terminus, End of the Line
text: When you planeswalk here, each player puts all creatures they control on the bottom of their deck in a random order.
Each card in your hand has miracle. Its miracle cost is equal to its mana cost minus {4}. (You may cast a card for its miracle cost when you draw it if it's the first card you drew this turn.)

faces.name: Grachtengordel
text: When you planeswalk here, each player creates a 3/2 Rondvaartboot Vehicle artifact token with crew 1.
All Vehicles have islandwalk and "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card."
Whenever chaos ensues, put a flood counter on target land. It becomes an Island in addition to its other types. Then draw a card for each flood counter among permanents on the battlefield.

faces.name: Georgia Technical Institute
text: Spells with the letter T in their names cost {1} less to cast.
Creatures with the letter T in their names have trample.
Whenever chaos ensues, this plane deals X damage to up to one target creature and you gain X life, where X is the number of Ts among names of permanents you control.

faces.name: Ureni's Lair
text: Whenever one or more creatures you control enter during your turn, put a flying counter on one of them. It becomes a Spirit Dragon with base power and toughness 5/5 in addition to its other types. This ability triggers only once each turn.
Whenever chaos ensues, Dragons you control gain menace and haste until end of turn.

faces.name: Fleem-for-All
text: When you planeswalk here and at the beginning of your upkeep, take Fleem and wake Fleem. If no Fleem, make Fleem. (Gain control of a creature named Fleem, Goben's Creation. Untap it. If no player controls one, create a Fleem, Goben's Creation token. It gains haste.)
Whenever chaos ensues, create ten 1/1 green Goblin creature tokens named Follower of Fleem.

faces.name: Chief Engineer (Rank)
text: Watchful Eye — At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gains vigilance until end of turn.
Miracle Worker — {5}: Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a nonland card. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Activate only once.

faces.name: Chief Medical Officer (Rank)
text: Bio-Filtration System — You start at 50 life.
Resuscitation Pack — {5}: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Activate only as a sorcery and only once.

faces.name: Elvish Impersonation Contest (Phenomenon)
text: When you encounter this phenomenon, each player creates an Elvish Impersonators token. You become the monarch. (It's a green Elf creature with "As this creature enters, roll a six-sided die twice. Its base power becomes the first result and its base toughness becomes the second result." and flavor text "Uh-hunh.")
(Then planeswalk away from this phenomenon.)

faces.name: Multiversal Field Trip
text: When you encounter this phenomenon, search the planar deck for a plane you've never planeswalked to before (like, ever), shuffle the planar deck, then planeswalk to that plane.

faces.name: Cat Café
text: When you planeswalk here and at the beginning of your upkeep, create a Food token.
Whenever you gain life, put that many +1/+1 counters on target creature you control. It gains trample until end of turn.
Whenever chaos ensues, create an X/X red Cat creature token with haste, where X is the greatest number of counters on a permanent you control.

faces.name: Explore the Local Scene
text: When you encounter this phenomenon, starting with you, each player in turn order may suggest a local restaurant or tourist attraction. Each player who made a suggestion creates a Map token.
(Then planeswalk away from this phenomenon.)

faces.name: Waffle Hovel
text: Whenever you attack and whenever a creature you control fights, create a Food token.
{5}: Target creature you control fights target creature an opponent controls.
When you planeswalk away from here, each player who controls the most Food tokens draws two cards.

faces.name: Sandbox Black Market
text: When you planeswalk here and at the beginning of your upkeep, exile target nontoken creature an opponent controls. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost.
Whenever chaos ensues, exile all creatures. Starting with you, each player may cast a creature card exiled with this plane without paying its mana cost.

faces.name: First Officer (Rank)
text: Executive Authority — Your starting and maximum hand size is eight.
Second in Command — {2}: You may activate another player's rank ability this turn (even if they already have). Activate only once.

faces.name: Jace's Thuuuuunder Junction
text: When you planeswalk here, exile all outlaws until the game leaves this plane. (Assassins, Mercenaries, Pirates, Rogues, and Warlocks are outlaws.)
Players can't commit crimes. (Targeting opponents, anything they control, and/or cards in their graveyards is a crime.)
Whenever chaos ensues, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, then put an additional +1/+1 counter on those creatures for each outlaw card exiled with this plane.

faces.name: Neon Graveyard
text: During your turn, for each color, you may cast a spell of that color from your graveyard. If a spell cast this way would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead. If you cast a permanent spell this way, it enters with a finality counter on it.
When chaos ensues, add {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}. Spend this mana only to cast spells from your graveyard.

faces.name: Goldengrave
text: When you planeswalk here, each player secretly chooses a Tarkir clan. Reveal the choices, then each player joins the clan they chose for as long you are on this plane.
Whenever you attack a player not in your clan, creatures attacking that player get +2/+0 until end of turn.
Whenever chaos ensues, each player in your clan draws two cards and creates a Treasure token.

faces.name: Through the Wormhole
text: When you encounter this phenomenon, the player who is farthest from their home draws three cards. Each other player creates a Lander token. (It's an artifact with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle."
(Then planeswalk away from this phenomenon.)

faces.name: Alesha's Arena
text: When you planeswalk here and at the beginning of your upkeep, You may mill three cards.
Whenever you attack, return target creature card with power 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Whenever chaos ensues, put three +1/+1 counters on target creature you control. It gains first strike until end of turn.

faces.name: Omega-Level Threat
text: When you encounter this phenomenon, for each unique piece of Super Hero media a player has consumed in the last month, that player may save up to that many creatures. Destroy each creature not saved this way.
(Then planeswalk away from this phenomenon.)

faces.name: Ikori-All-You-Can-Eat
text: When you planeswalk here and at the beginning of your upkeep, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a non-Human creature card. Put that card into your hand. It perpetually gains mutate {4}. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
Whenever chaos ensues, destroy all Humans. They can't be regenerated.

faces.name: Jalira's Showroom
text: Whenever you cast a creature spell, draw a card, then discard a card.

Whenever chaos ensues, destroy up to one target creature. Its controller reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a creature card. That player puts that card onto the battlefield, then puts the rest on the bottom of their library in a random order.

faces.name: Cola Bottling Plant
text: When you planeswalk here and whenever a land you control enters, bottle the top card of your library. (Exile it. You may play it this turn.)
Whenever chaos ensues and when you planeswalk away from here, each player puts each bottled card they own into their graveyard and creates that many 1/1 green Plant creature tokens.

faces.name: You Encounter a Beholder!
text: When you encounter this phenomenon, starting with you, each player rolls a d20. Players who control their commander roll with advantage. (They roll 2d20 and ignore the lower roll.)
1-9 | Create a Treasure token.
10-19 | Draw a card.
20 | Create a Treasure token, draw a card, then you may cast a spell from your hand without paying its mana cost.
(Then planeswalk away from this phenomenon.)

faces.name: Gravitational Capture
text: When you encounter this phenomenon, each player reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a nonland permanent card with mana value 5 or less. Each player puts that card onto the battlefield under the control of the player on their left and the other cards they revealed on the bottom of their library in a random order.
(Then planeswalk away from this phenomenon).

faces.name: Mysterious Planet
text: Station (Tap another creature you control: Put charge counters equal to its power on this Planet. Station only as a sorcery.)

6+: Whenever you attack a player, create a Lander token. (It's an artifact with {2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Search your library for a basic land card, put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.")
Whenever chaos ensues, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Untap those creatures.

faces.name: Crime Scene
text: While voting, you may vote an additional time.

When you planeswalk here and whenever chaos ensues, each player secretly votes for a creature and then the results are revealed. Destroy each creature that received the most votes or tied for most votes. Put two +1/+1 counters on each other creature that received at least one vote.

faces.name: Jace's Capenna
text: When you planeswalk here and at the beginning of your upkeep, create a 3/3 white Angel creature token with flying.
Whenever an Angel dies, its controller chooses up to one target noncreature permanent. Destroy it.
Whenever chaos ensues, create a 3/3 white Angel creature token with flying for each time the planar die was rolled this turn.

faces.name: Lorwyn Arena
text: When you planeswalk here, and at the beginning of your upkeep, clash with target opponent. (Each clashing player reveals the top card of their library, then puts that card on their choice of the top or bottom. A player wins if their card had a greater mana value.)
Whenever you win a clash, draw a card. Then you may cast a spell from your hand without paying its mana cost.
Whenever chaos ensues, clash with target opponent.

faces.name: LobbyCon
text: When you planeswalk here and at the beginning of your upkeep, create a Sleep Deprived token. (It's an artifact token with "{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: Tap target creature and put a stun counter on it.")
Whenever chaos ensues, put X +1/+1 counters on up to one target creature, where X is the number of hours of sleep you got last night. (Be honest. We can see your eyes.)

faces.name: Flamekin Village Square
text: Each creature spell you cast has evoke. Its evoke cost is equal to its mana cost reduced by {3}. (You may cast a spell for its evoke cost. If you do, it's sacrificed when it enters.)
Whenever chaos ensues, return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.

faces.name: Bagel Valley
text: When you planeswalk here and at the beginning of your upkeep, put an everything counter on target creature or land you control. (It has all creature types or all land types.)
Whenever you attack, discover X, where X is number of everything counters among permanents.
Whenever chaos ensues, for each permanent you control with an everything counter on it, create a token that's a copy of it.

faces.name: Head of Security (Rank)
text: Weapons Hot — Attacking nontoken creatures you control get +1/+0.
Confine to Quarters — {2}: Remove all attacking creatures from combat. Activate only once.

faces.name: The Merch Booth
text: When you planeswalk here, at the beginning of your upkeep, and whenever you roll the planar die, you get ❖. Spend ❖ only during your turn.
❖ — Create a Food token.
❖ ❖ — Create a 1/1 colorless Toy artifact creature token named Fblthp.
❖ ❖ ❖ ❖ — Draw two cards.

faces.name: Jace's Zendikar
text: Whenever a player taps a permanent for mana, they add one mana of any type that permanent produced.
A player losing unspent mana causes that player to lose that much life.

Whenever chaos ensues, drain target player's mana. (They untap each land they control, then activate a mana ability of each of those lands, then they lose all unspent mana. Burn! You add the mana they lost this way.)

faces.name: Ultimate Team-Up
text: Noncreature spells you cast have teamwork 4. (As an additional cost to cast a noncreature spell, you may tap any number of creatures you control with total power 4 or more.)

Whenever you cast a spell that one or more creatures you control helped to cast, you may copy that spell and choose new targets for the copy. Do this only once each turn. (Tapping a creature to pay a cost or for mana counts as helping. So does sacrificing it, if you're a monster.)

faces.name: The Big Aquarium
text: Marine animals can't block or be blocked by non-marine animals. (Marine animals live in the ocean or other salt- water environments.)

Whenever you attack, for each player you're attacking, create a 1/1 blue Fish creature token that's tapped and attacking that player. If chaos ensued this turn, instead create a 5/5 blue Whale Shark creature token that's tapped and attacking that player.

faces.name: Captain (Rank)
text: The Big Chair — You choose the starting player. You start the game with a Treasure token.
Command Codes — {4}: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. Until end of turn, it gains haste and can't attack its owner. Activate only once.

faces.name: Fractured Realities
text: When you encounter this phenomenon, reveal cards from the top of your planar deck until you reveal two plane cards. Simultaneously planeswalk to both of them. Put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your planar deck in a random order. For each of those planes, if a triggered ability of that plane triggers, that ability triggers an additional time. (This includes abilities that trigger when you planeswalk there.)

faces.name: National Museum
text: When you planeswalk here, each player searches their library for a nonland permanent card with their favorite art, shows it off to the table, puts that card into their hand, then shuffles.
As you cast your first spell each turn, describe your favorite thing about it in your best museum curator voice. It costs 2 less to cast.
Whenever chaos ensues, choose a Magic artist. For each nontoken permanent you control by that artist, create a token that's a copy of it.

faces.name: Clash Me Outside
text: When you planeswalk here and at the beginning of your upkeep, clash with each opponent. The winner creates an Omenpath enchantment token with "Sacrifice this enchantment: Choose one - Planeswalk; or chaos ensues. Activate only as a sorcery." (Each clashing player reveals the top card of their library, then puts that card on their choice of the top or bottom. A player wins if their card had a greater mana value.)
Whenever chaos ensues, clash with each opponent. The winner may cast the card they revealed without paying its mana cost.

faces.name: Strixhaven Rivalry
text: When you planeswalk here, each player enrolls in a Strixhaven college for as long this plane remains face up.
Whenever you cast a spell that shares a color with your college, put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature.
Whenever chaos ensues, double the number of each kind of counter on any number of target permanents you control.
